name: Anoctamin5関連肢帯型筋ジストロフィー

summary.text: A form of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy most often characterized by an adult onset (but ranging from 11 to 51 years) of mainly proximal lower limb weakness, with difficulties standing on tiptoes being one of the initial signs. Proximal upper limb and distal lower limb weakness is also common, as well as atrophy of the quadriceps (most commonly), biceps brachii, and lower leg muscles. Calf hypertrophy has also been reported in some cases. LGMD2L progresses slowly, with most patients remaining ambulatory until late adulthood.
summary.evidence: A form of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy

symptoms.text: Proximal upper limb and distal lower limb weakness
